svg.aria-label: Box, 45 by 30 cm, inside a cabinet 100 by 80 cm and 90 cm high, seen from the front right. Lenses that fit: a 6 mm lens looking down, a 4 mm lens in a back corner and a 4 mm lens in a front corner. An 8 mm lens in the other front corner would have to be 125 cm away, outside the cabinet; from inside it, the box is cut off.
